title: Playback
description: Playback sync (capability playback, build 10). Phone is the state source in 0.10.0: playback-state carries the now-playing snapshot phone->Mac (title/artist/album/package/state/position/duration/artwork); playback-cmd carries transport commands Mac->phone (play/pause/toggle/next/prev). State is event-driven push (MediaController callbacks, immediate on track/state change; receivers interpolate position locally from position_ms+updated_ms). Commands are edge-triggered nonce-idempotent. updated_ms orders states (greater wins, ties keep local). Artwork is optional downscaled JPEG/PNG base64 max 131072 bytes (~128KB b64); receivers drop oversize/invalid artwork fail-soft and keep metadata. Titles/artists/albums truncated by senders (128 chars); receivers enforce fail-soft. Decoders ignore unknown fields.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.10.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

title.description: Track title (playback-state only). Never logged verbatim server-side beyond lengths.

state.description: Transport state (playback-state only). Absent means stopped.

updated_ms.description: Unix milliseconds of this snapshot; greater wins, ties keep local.

artwork_b64.description: Downscaled cover art JPEG/PNG base64 (~128KB max). Optional; receivers drop oversize/invalid fail-soft.

origin.description: Which side produced this message; receivers drop echoes of their own origin.
